BiblicalUsage: Yâpha means to shine, to shine forth with light. The LORD shined forth from Mount Paran when He came with ten thousands of saints, and Job wished the light would never shine on the day of his birth.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's shining is His coming near, and the same light that blesses His people is terrible to the day of darkness.
